name: Leistine
backstory: Zoll, disguised as Harper Leistine, is a Doppelganger posing as a lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Leistine was killed and impersonated some time ago.
